optimizedContext.value:
# ConfigWriter

## Rules
- Interface (not abstract): `initProject`, `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`.
- `initProject(InitProjectOptions)` → `InitProjectResult`. Options: projectRoot, schemaRef, workspaceId, specsPath, force?. Result: configPath, schemaRef, workspaces, metadataCachePath.
- Behaviour: write specd.yaml (omit storage by default); create specs + `.specd/{changes,drafts,discarded,archive}`; ensure metadata cache; append `/.specd/metadata/` to root .gitignore (default fs layout only); `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore`; ignore `specd.local.yaml` + `specd.local.*.yaml`.
- Exists + !force → `AlreadyInitialisedError`; force overwrites.
- `addPlugin(configPath, type, name, config?)` — no dupes; write config with name. `removePlugin(configPath, type, name)`.
- Delivery: `createConfigWriter()` from @specd/core only — no FsConfigWriter import. Prefer SpecdConfig snapshot over listPlugins for reads.

## Constraints
- application/ports/; no fs/yaml at port. AlreadyInitialisedError application-layer. plugins shape: `{ agents: Array<{name, config?}> }`.
